en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a full-length studio portrait of a man in traditional Ottoman/Turkish attire. He wears a wrapped headscarf, a dark shirt with several medals pinned to his chest, a wide sash around his waist, and loose trousers. He rests one hand on a decorative prop resembling a small tree or plant. In the upper-left corner there is a green postage stamp with Arabic/Ottoman script, partially canceled with a round postmark. Handwritten text and a printed caption appear at the bottom.
